cxx_vs_c_findings.modeling_convention: Embedded C++ (-fno-rtti -fno-exceptions) classes and RTKit C drivers are reconstructed in freestanding C11 using explicit vtable structs (const void *vt at +0x00) and _Static_assert-verified member offsets.

claim_policy.reconstructed_c_gate: Function is compiled from clean freestanding C11 (zero banned Hex-Rays idioms), passes >=1 direct ARMv7E-M Unicorn differential test at its raw RVA in ../../../aopf with 0 divergences, and kills all 3 constant-return stub mutations (bx lr, movs r0,#0;bx lr, movs r0,#1;bx lr).
claim_policy.retained_native_gate: Must contain original raw instruction bytes verified byte-for-byte against ../../../aopf. Count is 0; hand-written arch-entry and C shim routines are classified pending_c (@shim).
claim_policy.shim_policy: 70 arch-entry, noreturn panic/assert, constant-return, and partial ioctl/free C shims are tagged @shim in C source and counted in pending_c.

known_deviations.description: Verbatim binary-backed .rodata.rom_bank (0x00064000..0x00077B14) and .data.ram_bank (0x20800000..0x2081A0B0) preserve 100% of raw firmware constants, C++/RTKit vtables, TLV metadata, and initialized driver structs. Function pointer slots targeting reconstructed C driver/vector entry RVAs are bridged at their exact original RVAs via link/aopf.ld + vt_trampolines.c; slots targeting pending_c functions remain raw ROM_TEXT RVAs until those C++/RTKit functions are reconstructed.
